_meta.confirmedRule: confirmed=true only where the figure was read on the cited page itself. confirmed=false marks figures taken from search-result snippets of pages that blocked automated fetching (Home Depot US, Lowe's, Angi, Checkatrade, Wayfair, Argos, Harvey Norman Ireland, sonos.com, adt.com, shop.tesla.com and others) or from secondary sources; value null means unpublished.

primaryRetailers.US: IKEA US (furniture, lighting, kitchens); Home Depot, Benjamin Moore (finishes); Best Buy/Samsung (TVs)
primaryRetailers.MX: IKEA Mexico and Liverpool (Coppel, Walmart and Amazon Mexico blocked fetching); Home Depot Mexico (flooring, paint, bath)
primaryRetailers.GB: IKEA UK; B&Q (finishes, bath); Samsung UK/Currys (TVs)
primaryRetailers.IE: IKEA Ireland; Woodie's (finishes, bath); DID Electrical (TVs). Harvey Norman Ireland returned HTTP 403 throughout.

caveats: IKEA prices were read from category listing pages on 2026-09-30; sale prices carry regularValue.
Wayfair (US) and Argos (UK) returned 403/429 to fetching, so IKEA is the furniture source in every market.
Trade wage figures (BLS, Job Bank, CONASAMI minimums, Irish sectoral employment order) are what the worker is paid, not what a customer is charged; customer rates are separate cost-guide records.
Home Depot Mexico category pages show cents as extra digits; the values here are already corrected.
IKEA mattress warranty is 10 years in current (2025) documents in US, UK, CA and IE; the older 25-year US warranty dates from 2021.
All game consoles rose in price during 2026 (PS5 from 2026-04-02, Xbox from 2026-08-01, Switch 2 from 2026-09-01); figures here are the post-rise prices.
Dining-table seat counts are not stated by IKEA; seats are given for table-and-chair sets.
NAHB life-expectancy figures come from the 2007 study (NAHB no longer hosts it); some table columns in the PDF were misaligned and were checked against the report text.
